info.scriptSrcText: property this, scoreList, lockFlash, lockOutFlashCount1, lockOutFlashCount2global gLevelScoreList, gScoreTotal, gLockOuton beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  scoreList = []  gScoreTotal = 0  repeat with i = 1 to 9    gScoreTotal = gScoreTotal + gLevelScoreList[i]    calcScore = gLevelScoreList[i]    tempString = EMPTY    repeat with j = 7 down to 1      temp = calcScore mod power(10, j - 1)      temp1 = (calcScore - temp) / power(10, j - 1)      calcScore = temp      tempString = tempString & string(integer(temp1))    end repeat    scoreList.add(tempString)  end repeat  calcScore = gScoreTotal  tempString = EMPTY  repeat with j = 7 down to 1    temp = calcScore mod power(10, j - 1)    temp1 = (calcScore - temp) / power(10, j - 1)    calcScore = temp    tempString = tempString & string(integer(temp1))  end repeat  scoreList.add(tempString)  this.member.text = scoreList[1] & RETURN & scoreList[2] & RETURN & scoreList[3] & RETURN & scoreList[4] & RETURN & RETURN & scoreList[10]  member("SubmitScore", "Gfx").text = string(gScoreTotal)  if gLevelScoreList[1] and gLevelScoreList[2] and gLevelScoreList[3] then    if gLockOut = "0" then      gLockOut = "1"    end if  end if  if gLevelScoreList[4] and gLevelScoreList[5] and gLevelScoreList[6] then    if gLockOut = "1" then      gLockOut = "2"    end if  end if  if (the environment).runMode = "Author" then    gLockOut = "2"  end if  case gLockOut of    "0":    "1":      sprite(19).locV = -1000    "2":      sprite(19).locV = -1000      sprite(20).locV = -1000  end case  lockOutFlashCount2 = 0  lockOutFlashCount1 = 0endon exitFrame  if (sprite(19).blend = 0) and (lockOutFlashCount1 = 0) then    lockOutFlashCount1 = 10  end if  if lockOutFlashCount1 > 0 then    sprite(19).blend = 100 * (lockOutFlashCount1 mod 2)    lockOutFlashCount1 = lockOutFlashCount1 - 1  end if  if (sprite(20).blend = 0) and (lockOutFlashCount2 = 0) then    lockOutFlashCount2 = 10  end if  if lockOutFlashCount2 > 0 then    sprite(20).blend = 100 * (lockOutFlashCount2 mod 2)    lockOutFlashCount2 = lockOutFlashCount2 - 1  end ifend
info.name: Hi-Scores
